تستذهنوا (form X)
# تَسْتَذْهِنُوا (tastaḏhinū) /tas.tað.hi.nuː/: second-person masculine plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِسْتَذْهَنَ (istaḏhana)
# تُسْتَذْهَنُوا (tustaḏhanū) /tus.tað.ha.nuː/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِسْتَذْهَنَ (istaḏhana)
